question: In what form and location is the vital breath present within all living beings?
premises: Breath fills and moves as air
This air is present in all beings
It is firmly situated within them
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam (neuter) with vāyuḥ (masculine) is slightly irregular
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated within all living beings.
